description: The elevation scope of Content first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: elevation.definition
answers.why: Space separates groups; lines would interrupt reading.

answers.question: elevation.lands
answers.why: Menus and dialogs are the only layers.

usage.why: Cards stay flat on the page; shadows are for floating things.
The dimmed page focuses the reader on the dialog.

elevation.card.headline: Space, not shadows.
elevation.card.line: Cards sit flat; the space around them does the work.

elevation.overlay.headline: A soft lift.
elevation.overlay.line: Menus and dialogs rise gently above the page.
